import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the memmove function prototype
memmove = gsl.memmove
memmove.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t]
memmove.restype = ctypes.c_void_p

# Function to perform memory move using the C memmove function
def memmove_python(dest, source, length):
    dest_array = (ctypes.c_char * length).from_buffer(dest)
    source_array = (ctypes.c_char * length).from_buffer(source)
    memmove(ctypes.addressof(dest_array), ctypes.addressof(source_array), length)
    return dest

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Basic copy
    src = bytearray(b'Hello World')
    dest = bytearray(b' ' * len(src))
    memmove_python(dest, src, len(src))
    assert dest == src, f"Test case 1 failed: {dest} != {src}"

    # Test case 2: Partial copy
    src = bytearray(b'Hello World')
    dest = bytearray(b' ' * len(src))
    memmove_python(dest, src, 5)
    assert dest[:5] == src[:5], f"Test case 2 failed: {dest[:5]} != {src[:5]}"

    # Test case 3: Zero length
    src = bytearray(b'Hello World')
    dest = bytearray(b' ' * len(src))
    memmove_python(dest, src, 0)
    assert dest == bytearray(b' ' * len(src)), f"Test case 3 failed: {dest} != {bytearray(b' ' * len(src))}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
